videos.title: Can Your PC Run GTA 6? What the PS5 Tells Us
videos.brief: Owner request Nov 26. GTA 6 launched on PS5/Xbox Nov 19, 2026; Digital Foundry: 30 fps cap, ~1440p internal, no performance mode, PS5 Pro steadiest. No PC version announced; GamesBeat (Oct 13, 2026) reports PC in Q1 2027 (unofficial). Use the console hardware to estimate what a PC needs for 60 fps; verdict: don't buy for it until Rockstar posts specs, and what to prioritise if you upgrade.
videos.note: Being built in the owner's chat session (not by the scheduled run).

videos.title: DDR4 or DDR5 in 2026? RAM Prices Changed the Answer
videos.brief: Memory shortage: Nov 23, 2026 median DDR5 ~$18/GB vs DDR4 ~$8/GB (RamRadar); 32 GB DDR5 kits ~$430-600. Verdict by platform: keep DDR4 on AM4/LGA1700, DDR5 only if buying AM5/LGA1851. Different angle from 03 (types of RAM).

videos.title: You Probably Bought Too Big a Power Supply
videos.keyword: how many watts psu do i need
videos.brief: What happens if your PSU is too small vs too big. Three real builds with measured draw, transient spikes (ATX 3.x), the 50% load efficiency sweet spot. Must not repeat 10 (how a PSU works) or Short 01s14; this one is a sizing verdict.

videos.title: Intel or AMD for a Normal PC? A Clear Answer
videos.brief: Two $800 builds, one Intel, one AMD, judged on what a normal person does (games, browsing, upgrades later, power use). Zen 6 and Nova Lake reportedly slipped to 2027: say so, with the month. Upgrade path (AM5 vs LGA1851/new LGA1954) is the deciding point.
